package_info.why_malicious: The package is vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) attacks via SVG files, allowing attackers to trigger Denial of Service (DoS) or Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) by processing maliciously crafted SVG files containing external DTD references.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
<!DOCTYPE svg SYSTEM "http://localhost:2323">
<svg version="1.1" baseProfile="full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="20">
  <text x="5" y="15" fill="red">I♡XML!</text>
</svg>
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the SVG parser processes the external DTD reference in the DOCTYPE declaration, causing the application to make an HTTP request to the specified host (localhost:2323), which can be abused for SSRF or DoS.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The SVG file contains an external DTD reference, which is not required for normal image rendering and can cause the application to make arbitrary network requests.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal SVG files should not require external DTDs or cause the application to initiate network connections during parsing.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: External DTDs are rarely used in legitimate SVG files, but may be present in some advanced or legacy workflows.
key_indicators: Presence of <!DOCTYPE ... SYSTEM ...> in SVG files
Network requests initiated during SVG parsing
Unusual HTTP requests to internal or external hosts triggered by image processing

attack_chain.action: Attacker uploads or submits a crafted SVG file containing an external DTD reference.
attack_chain.leads_to: Application parses the SVG file and processes the external DTD.

attack_chain.action: Application makes an HTTP request to the specified host in the DTD (e.g., localhost:2323), potentially causing SSRF or DoS.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential service disruption (DoS) or internal network exposure (SSRF).

behavioral_signatures: SVG file parsing triggers outbound network requests
Presence of external DTD references in user-supplied SVG files
Unexpected HTTP requests to internal or external hosts during image processing
file_indicators: SVG files with references to non-standard or internal hosts
network_indicators: HTTP requests to arbitrary hosts (e.g., localhost, internal IPs) during SVG processing
Unusual User-Agent strings (e.g., Java/1.7.0_60-ea) in requests originating from image processing services
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for SVG files containing external DTD references (<!DOCTYPE ... SYSTEM ...>) and alert on any network activity initiated during SVG parsing, especially requests to internal or unexpected hosts. Implement XML parser hardening to disable external entity resolution for SVG files.
